## Promise

Link to the promise on the tracker, or its id.

## Proposed status

One of: in_progress, kept, partial, broken, superseded.

## Evidence URL

A public record: a vote, a signed bill, a veto, a budget, an official act, or their own later statement.

## What the evidence shows

A short note a stranger could check. A hunch is not enough. Pending stays pending until this evidence is public.
